hook: Raat ke do baje, Peepal ke neeche Dadi loriyan gaa rahi thi…
hook_text: Peepal se aayi Dadi ki lori…
feedback: Solid cold-open punch and high emotional stakes. A few cuts (like Cut 3) briefly drop the urgency created by Cut 1 and 2, but the pacing picks up quickly into a tragic, spine-chilling climax. The image descriptions and dialogue balance horror and family sacrifice perfectly.
lines: Raat ke do baje, Peepal ke neeche Dadi loriyan gaa rahi thi…
Par Dadi toh ghar ke andar gahri neend mein soi thi!
Rathpur gaon mein sannata tha aur chand poora chamak raha tha.
Unnees saal ki Meera achanak bahar se aati meethi aawaz sunkar jaagi.
Usne dekha uska chhota bhai Sonu sammohan mein bahar badh raha tha.
Peepal ke ped ke neeche safed saree mein Dadi muskura rahi theen.
Meera bhaagi aur Sonu ko pakadkar zor se chillai— 'Dadi!'
Tabhi peeche kamre mein diya jala… asli Dadi toh andar soi theen!
Meera ne bolna chaha, par uske gale se koi aawaz nahi nikli.
Gaon ke niyam ke mutabiq, aawaz dete hi Meera ki aatma ped mein sama gayi.
Agar raat ko Peepal se apnon ki aawaz aaye… toh jawab mat dena!
